title: SecOps-NG Sovereignty Ownership
description: Closed alphabet for the beneficial-ownership pointer of an external provider. Imported by the supply-chain evidence stream's `dependencies[].sovereignty_classification.ownership` field. Beneficial ownership, NOT registered-office country — the latter is trivially gamed and not what the NIS2 supply-chain overlay reads. The rolled-up `sovereignty_band` is a deterministic function of (residency, ownership, sub-processor chain).

x_ownership_definitions.eu_owned: Beneficial ownership is wholly EU/EEA — no non-EU/EEA controlling interest at any level of the ownership chain.
x_ownership_definitions.eu_majority_owned: Beneficial ownership is majority EU/EEA but includes a non-trivial non-EU/EEA minority. Promoted as a distinct band because some sovereign-procurement frameworks treat majority ownership as sufficient.
x_ownership_definitions.non_eu_owned: Beneficial ownership is non-EU/EEA controlled — the operator's KB has confirmed a non-EU/EEA controlling interest.
x_ownership_definitions.unknown: The operator's supplier KB has not pinned ownership for this provider yet. Treated by the band rollup as `unknown` rather than assumed worst-case.
